description: Takes its radius from rounded-sm and rounded-2xl in place of rounded-floor and rounded-card, which the tokens item removes. Every radius renders at the same size.
An AvatarGroup rendered as a button or link is at least 24px wide, and 44px on a touch screen, so a one-avatar trigger meets the hit-area minimum.
Component introduced: Avatar, AvatarImage, AvatarFallback and AvatarGroup, moved from the avatar experiment.
